noctis-tokinibara.name: Noctis Tokinibara
noctis-tokinibara.description: The pure Tokinibara flower, consumed by obsession, wanders along the River of Forgetfulness. Faced with Izanami's scheme of using rebirth as bait and implanting the spider lily to corrupt souls, how will Tokinibara choose?
noctis-tokinibara.story: A noble soul wandering by The River of Three Crossings, a person of ill fate on a path of no return. Izanami's swelling ambition has reshaped this mortal flesh, yet cannot eliminate the chilling ghostly aura of the deceased.
noctis-tokinibara.capabilities: A powerful Fighter with strong Debuff abilities. Can steal extra Energy gained by enemies and increase the Energy enemies need to consume when casting their Ultimate.

occult-sorcerer.name: Occult Sorcerer
occult-sorcerer.description: Occult Sorcerer is a mage part of the Alice's forces, her race is unknown, but in the context in which she first appears is possible for her to be an orc sorcerer. Her skin tone is a pale red, hair blonde and her eyes bright with a strong light blue bright; she has a tattoo in her forehead that brights just as her eyes; wears a green hood with the elemental sign printed on it, on her shoulders rest a long green cape with yellow leaf design inside and in her body wears a green dress which has a silver belt with a light blue shard in the center; she uses white globes and in her hands carries a spell book and her branch staff which holds a crystal sphere.

selena.name: Selena
selena.description: At the south of the Monian Empire, a bottomless abyss is carved into the desert landscape. The locals call this place the Abyss of Shadows. Few know that deep within the Dark Abyss, the most terrifying demon of the Dawn Earth is sealed — the Lord of the Abyss. Over the centuries, the seal of the Abyss has slowly faded, giving way to the ravenous will of the Abyss. The demons strengthened their control over the darkness. Many fanatics offered sacrifices to the Abyss, unknowingly feeding the demons formed from dark energy, always hiding within the shadows. Selena, a young dark elf, was offered to them as a sacrifice in exchange for dark energy. The Abyss Demon filled Selena with despair and pain, piercing every cell of her body. Just as Selena was nearly consumed by darkness, a miracle occurred. A mysterious warm blue light enveloped her and seemed to struggle with the dark abyss for control over her body. When Selena awoke, she found herself still lying in the Abyss, but her skin now emitted a strange blue glow, and her once lavender eyes were filled with a majestic crimson radiance — the Abyss Demon was resting inside her. Then the Will of the Abyss spoke: This girl is deeply loved, and that love protected her from being consumed by darkness. The Abyss and the Moon God, two opposing forces, have reached balance within her body. An ancient and deep voice echoed in the minds of the demons: Leave this girl to me. She will become the strongest warrior of the Abyss! The demons obeyed the command and left Selena. She forgot her past, but quickly discovered that she could manipulate the dark magic of the Abyss. She could absorb the power of the Abyss into her body to transform into a demoness capable of tearing enemies apart. The Will of the Abyss echoed in her voice, granting Selena unquestionable authority over the Abyss demons. Even Alice, the proud Queen of Blood Magic, felt uncertain when she looked at the dark young elf — not only because Alice could sense the terrifying power lying within this seemingly cute and mischievous girl named Selena.

singularity-lunox.name: Singularity Lunox
singularity-lunox.description: (in-game Info) Through the Energy Channel of the dream world, Lunox seized the transcendent might of Order and Chaos, ascending to the pinnacle of power. As challenges loomed amidst the enigmatic haze of the Land of Dawn's uncertain destiny, she pressed forward, unyielding and relentless. With unwavering resolve, she invokes the Twilight Orb's potential, shattering the veils of illusion. Through the shroud of deception, she embraced the veritable truth, becoming the harbinger of eternity within the domain of the Twilight Orb.
